svg.title: The little wreck and the gull's lookout
svg.desc: Hand-written two-piece wooden wreck on a sandy islet. Front hull faces under open decks, snapped ribs, a tied spar, algae, recovered planks, flowers and a beachcomber's barrel. Exact Home bush and bridge-jetty-5 geometry is copied inline. Flat fills only.

g.title: Low round leafy bush
g.desc: Retains the low broad dome, with small leafy notches added around its edge. No ground shadow. Bottom-centre ground anchor (65, 100). Ducky height 130.
